scripts.setup: bun run db:up && echo 'Waiting for databases to start...' && sleep 3 && bun run db:migrate
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -o -e .env -- pnpm --filter @saas/db exec prisma migrate dev --schema=prisma/schema.prisma --name init
scripts.postinstall: pnpm exec zenstack generate --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.zmodel --no-compile && pnpm --filter @saas/db run build || (test -n "$VERCEL" && echo 'Postinstall failed on Vercel, but continuing as only web is required')
